slices.behaviour: One function answers whether a slice's plan covers a path: normalise and covers live in harness/paths.py, calibration imports them back, and guard.py, triage.py's _slice_files_check and triage.py's file_facts all call covers instead of comparing exactly. The fourth of those was F1 of the first review.
slices.failure_reason: NoSecondReaderTest's sixth case failed with "AssertionError: Lists differ: [(2, 'return cost in (planned, actual_prior)')] != []": the instrument flagged a membership test against a word a plan shares with something else as a second reader of the plan-coverage question. The earlier reds of this slice are records 6, 7, 8, 22, 29, 36 and 45, one per property three reviews had to find.
